grades.quote: C.BEQZ performs conditional control transfers. The offset is sign-extended and added to the `pc` to form the branch target address. It can therefore target a ±256 B range. C.BEQZ takes the branch if the value in register _rs1_ ′ is zero. It expands to `beq rs1′, x0, offset` .
grades.reason: Gives the sign-extended-offset-plus-PC calculation and explicitly connects it to BEQ through expansion.
